_about: Benzene (1) + Ethanol (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 101.33 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of benzene, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Wang, X.[Xue], Xu, W.[Weiwei], Li, Y.[Yonghong], Wang, J.[Jianxiong], He, F.[Fan], Phase equilibria of three binary systems containing 2,5-dimethylthiophene and 2-ethylthiophene in hydrocarbons, Fluid Phase Equilib. 409 (2016) 30-36
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7, 8. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.12 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
